 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = 9
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    r_edges = [-1] + rows + [h]
    c_edges = [-1] + cols + [w]
    panels = []
    for ra, rb in zip(r_edges, r_edges[1:]):
        for ca, cb in zip(c_edges, c_edges[1:]):
            panels.append([grid[r][c] for r in range(ra + 1, rb) for c in range(ca + 1, cb)])
    # Background is the most frequent non-divider color other than the marker.
    freq = Counter(v for p in panels for v in p if v not in (sep, 5))
    background = freq.most_common(1)[0][0] if freq else 0
    out = []
    i = 0
    for ra, rb in zip(r_edges, r_edges[1:]):
        row = []
        for ca, cb in zip(c_edges, c_edges[1:]):
            p = panels[i]
            i += 1
            row.append(1 if sum(v == 5 for v in p) == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
